timeoutPolicies.label: Tight
timeoutPolicies.detail: Fails quickly to preserve a caller fallback, but exposes more transient delay.

timeoutPolicies.label: Balanced
timeoutPolicies.detail: Leaves room for ordinary variation while retaining a bounded deadline.

timeoutPolicies.label: Long
timeoutPolicies.detail: Waits longer, risking more queued work and less time for a useful fallback.
